Synthetic Atlas College student support. The admissions office opens Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 16:00. Disability accommodation requests go to the student support desk, not admissions. Response target is five working days. French: Le bureau des admissions ouvre du lundi au vendredi de 09h à 16h. Les demandes d'aménagement vont au service d'aide aux étudiants. Arabic: مكتب القبول مفتوح من الاثنين إلى الجمعة من التاسعة إلى الرابعة. طلبات التيسير تقدم لمكتب دعم الطلبة. Synthetic Atlas College scholarship policy. Merit scholarship applications require a grade average of at least 16 out of 20 and a motivation letter. Applications close on 1 August. Awards cover half of tuition, excluding the registration deposit. French: La bourse au mérite exige une moyenne de 16 sur 20 et une lettre de motivation. Elle couvre la moitié des frais de scolarité. Synthetic Atlas College language policy. French-taught courses require a B2 French certificate. English-taught courses require IELTS 6.0. Darija: القراية فالعام ب 24000 درهم على ثلاثة ديال الدفعات كل وحدة ب 8000 درهم. التسبيق 1500 درهم ما كيرجعش.
